releases.description: Stability repair: restored the full real game catalogue, safe local game caching, Firebase profiles, and the in-app admin workspace.

changes.text: Restored discovery of the complete Offline HTML Games Pack catalogue instead of a truncated store.
Restored on-demand raw HTML installation, IndexedDB caching, and Blob URL playback.
Restored Firebase authentication and real profile data with URL and base64 avatar support.
Added the in-app admin control center with maintenance mode, catalogue tools, users, and release controls.
Made IndexedDB upgrades create missing object stores instead of throwing transaction errors.
Removed fake game-cover placeholders and use supplied catalogue covers or the Flash Games logo fallback.
Reworked the runtime to use targeted rendering and delegated events instead of repeated whole-app work.
Added themes, cleaner preferences, performance controls, stats, favorites, and custom notifications.

releases.description: Flash Games is now a real single-page glass interface wired back into the legacy catalogue, Firebase account system, moderation tools, and Confer social experience.

changes.text: Restored the real legacy Store catalogue and offline collection.
Integrated Firebase profile data, authentication, notifications, and admin moderation.
Added the Confer social section at its requested endpoint.
Added migrated repository update history to the Updates view.
Replaced the old Arc+ branding with Flash Games.
Rebuilt search, library, game launching, settings, and notifications around real data.
Removed fake Player identity, fake catalogue entries, and fake activity messages.
Initial direct home dashboard and library.
Initial Store and local library separation.
Introduced the v2 liquid-glass visual system.
